reference_answer: The chapter distinguishes evolutionary change from abrupt change. In addition, the project requires an extensive review of local records. By enforcing these explicit conditions, the model maintains stable performance across evaluation horizons without relying on ad hoc heuristics.
acceptable_alternatives: In our experimental protocol, the chapter distinguishes evolutionary change from abrupt change. Meanwhile, the project requires an extensive review of local records.
explanation_zh:
【高分技术微写作解析】
1. 词汇与熟词生义精准落地：自然融入了“evolutionary”（搭配：evolutionary change）与“extensive”（搭配：extensive evidence）；
2. 句子成分与尾重控制：每句均采用“简短主语（3–5 词）+ 强及物/系动词 + 后置宾语与条件状语”结构，毫无头重脚轻感；
3. 零 AI 痕迹：直接交代操作、约束与评估范围，文风贴近 NeurIPS/ICLR 顶会标准。注意：参考答案并非唯一正确表达。

reference_answer: Effective policy and research decisions require balancing practical benefits against resource constraints. Specifically, an excessive number of parameters can make interpretation difficult. For instance, wider entrances facilitate wheelchair access. At the same time, automation of data collection reduces repetitive work. On balance, decision-makers should evaluate these concrete trade-offs within local conditions rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all mandate.
acceptable_alternatives: While technological and institutional reforms can improve access, their implementation depends on concrete local constraints. An excessive number of parameters can make interpretation difficult. Furthermore, wider entrances facilitate wheelchair access. Nevertheless, automation of data collection reduces repetitive work.

【六级 / 雅思托福 / 演讲高分段落解析】
1. 四层论证逻辑：首句以简短动名词短语点明“效益与资源约束权衡”主题；第 2–3 句用 Specifically 与 For instance 引入具体机制与落地实例（融合“excessive”、“facilitate”）；第 4–5 句结合复习词“automation”进行让步限定（On balance...）；
2. 告别模板与空话：没有任何一句万能废话，每句都有具体动作（balancing, evaluate）和实在的制约因素；
3. 评分说明：参考范文仅作示范，任何符合四层论证结构、搭配准确且无语法病灶的原创段落均得满分。
